title: Bushen Zhuluan Decoction Ameliorates Diminished Ovarian Reserve in Rats via the SIRT1/HIF-1alpha Pathway.
authors: Shu, Chuqiang; Liang, Huizhen; Huang, Zhizhen; Wang, Ling; Yang, Ninglian; Zhou, Xiaoyi; Luo, Anqi; Xiang, Xinyu; Xia, Qiong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药补肾助卵煎剂通过SIRT1/HIF-1α通路改善大鼠卵巢储备功能，核心为卵巢细胞凋亡与信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diminished ovarian reserve (DOR) is a major cause of female infertility. In recent years, traditional Chinese medicine has displayed unique ameliorating effects on DOR. This study aims to investigate the therapeutic efficacy and molecular mechanisms of Bushen Zhuluan Decoction (BSZLD) in DOR. A rat model of DOR was established and treated with either BSZLD or Progynova (positive control). Estrous cycle monitoring, ovarian index calculation, hematoxylin-eosin staining, and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay were performed to assess ovarian reserve function. TUNEL staining, immunohistochemistry, and Western blotting were conducted to evaluate ovarian cell apoptosis. To elucidate the pharmacological basis of BSZLD, ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry was applied. Network pharmacology analysis, machine learning algorithms, and molecular docking were integrated to predict key active compounds and pathways. The role of the sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) and its downstream target hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha) signaling in BSZLD-mediated effects was verified using short hairpin RNA (shRNA) lentiviral-mediated interference. BSZLD significantly restored estrous cycle disturbances, increased ovarian index and follicle counts, and reduced atretic follicles and ovarian cell apoptosis in DOR rats. Serum anti-Mullerian hormone and estradiol levels were elevated, while follicle-stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone levels were reduced. The SIRT1/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway was a core regulatory axis for BSZLD action. BSZLD markedly upregulated SIRT1 expression while suppressing HIF-1alpha expression. Silencing SIRT1 using shRNA reduced SIRT1 levels, elevated HIF-1alpha expression, and significantly attenuated the therapeutic effects of BSZLD. BSZLD attenuates DOR in rats by activating the SIRT1/HIF-1alpha signaling, thereby suppressing ovarian cell apoptosis and restoring ovarian reserve function.
abstract_zh: 卵巢储备功能减退（DOR）是女性不孕的主要原因之一。近年来，中医药在改善DOR方面显示出独特的疗效。本研究旨在探讨补肾助卵汤（BSZLD）对DOR的治疗效果及其分子机制。建立DOR大鼠模型，并分别给予BSZLD或补佳乐（阳性对照）治疗。通过动情周期监测、卵巢指数计算、苏木精-伊红染色和酶联免疫吸附试验评估卵巢储备功能。采用TUNEL染色、免疫组织化学和Western blotting评估卵巢细胞凋亡。为阐明BSZLD的药理学基础，应用超高效液相色谱-串联质谱法。整合网络药理学分析、机器学习算法和分子对接以预测关键活性化合物和通路。使用短发夹RNA（shRNA）慢病毒介导的干扰验证sirtuin 1（SIRT1）及其下游靶点缺氧诱导因子1alpha（HIF-1alpha）信号在BSZLD介导效应中的作用。BSZLD显著恢复DOR大鼠的动情周期紊乱，增加卵巢指数和卵泡数量，并减少闭锁卵泡和卵巢细胞凋亡。血清抗苗勒管激素和雌二醇水平升高，而促卵泡激素和黄体生成素水平降低。SIRT1/HIF-1alpha信号通路是BSZLD作用的核心调控轴。BSZLD显著上调SIRT1表达，同时抑制HIF-1alpha表达。使用shRNA沉默SIRT1可降低SIRT1水平，升高HIF-1alpha表达，并显著减弱BSZLD的治疗效果。BSZLD通过激活SIRT1/HIF-1alpha信号，抑制卵巢细胞凋亡并恢复卵巢储备功能，从而减轻大鼠DOR。
